title: Lens Change Proposal
description: A structured, reviewable proposed modification to a Lens Manifest, generated by a Lens Engine from explicit user feedback (Adaptation Model Section 3.3). This schema is normative for the object's structure, so that independent engines agree on its shape and a conformance suite can exercise it; it confers no mobility. A Lens Change Proposal is Adaptation State: device-local, never published, exported, or exchanged between parties, and leaving the user's device only over an end-to-end-encrypted channel between the user's own devices (ADR-0006). It therefore has no media type in v0.1.

id.description: Stable proposal identifier, referenced by the manifest's versionHistory[].proposalId if the proposal is accepted. Constrained no further than that field is, so any identifier an engine can record in version history is a valid proposal id.

status.description: Where the proposal sits in the workflow of Adaptation Model Section 3. A proposal under modification remains 'pending': modification edits the change objects and returns to review. OPTIONAL — an engine that stores only pending proposals need not serialize it.

baseVersion.description: The Lens Manifest version this proposal applies to. Both lensVersion and hash are REQUIRED here, unlike in a Lens Diff, because a proposal whose base no longer matches the current manifest MUST be re-based or withdrawn rather than applied stale (Adaptation Model Section 3.6) — which is decidable only against a content hash.

changes.description: The proposed change as a Lens Diff fragment: one or more change objects sharing the Lens Diff change-object structure, so that proposal previews, subscription reviews, and history diffs read identically. Engines SHOULD present this fragment to the user as a full Lens Diff with comparison set to 'proposal-preview'.

evidenceSummary.description: Aggregate counts of the explicit feedback events that motivated the proposal, per event type and Domain Scope. The shape is closed and count-only by construction: it cannot express a URL, a content excerpt, a timestamp, or an individual event record, so a proposal cannot carry raw history even in an engine that would otherwise be careless with it (ADR-0006).

supportingEvents.description: Counts of feedback events supporting the proposal. MAY be empty for an exploratory proposal, which is exempt from evidenceThreshold (Adaptation Model Section 5); for any other proposal the totals here are what the effective evidenceThreshold is measured against.

counterEvents.description: Counts of countervailing feedback events, which engines SHOULD net against supporting ones (Adaptation Model Section 3.2). Recording them lets the review screen show the netting rather than only its result.

impact.description: The impact class of the proposal: the highest impact among its change objects, per Adaptation Model Section 4. This is the value the effective autoAcceptCeiling is compared against; auto-acceptance above the ceiling is a conformance violation (ADR-0010).

exploratory.description: True for an exploratory proposal — one not driven by accumulated evidence, permitted only under the explorer preset, which MUST be marked as exploratory and MUST NOT be auto-accepted regardless of impact class (Adaptation Model Section 5). Absent means false.

shadowEvaluation.description: A shadow-evaluation offer, or a reference to shadow-evaluation results held in Adaptation State (Adaptation Model Section 3.4). The results themselves are never inlined here: they record what the user subsequently read and MUST NOT be shared, exported, published, or included in any manifest or Lens Diff.

offered.description: Whether the engine offered shadow evaluation of this proposal.

resultsRef.description: Opaque device-local handle for the stored comparison. The character class excludes the solidus, so this cannot be a URL of visited content.

eventCount.description: One aggregate count: how many explicit feedback events of one type, in one Domain Scope, bear on this proposal. Nothing identifies an individual event.

eventType.description: An explicit feedback event type from Adaptation Model Section 3.1. Implicit signals — dwell time, scroll depth, hover, click-through — are not representable, because they MUST NOT count toward evidence thresholds in v0.1.

domainScope.description: The Domain Scope id these events accumulated against, matching the pattern the Lens Manifest imposes on domains[].id. Absent means the lens-wide default, against which feedback on unclassified content accumulates.

count.description: Number of events. An aggregate only: the events themselves stay in Adaptation State.
